title: [AUG-174] Research: mute/unmute microphone during a meeting without stopping the recording
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 6): the microphone cannot be muted in August during a meeting. In an office, background noise gets recorded and pollutes the transcript. A mute/unmute control that keeps the recording (and system audio) running is needed. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Audio pipeline described with file:line refs: mic track vs system-audio track, recording modes, live chunking, dual transcription.
- [ ] Mute approaches compared (gain to zero / silence frames / track pause / gap markers) for: timeline sync between tracks, live transcription, post-recording transcription, Windows (WASAPI/Stereo Mix/VB-Cable) and macOS (audiotee/BlackHole).
- [ ] UI placement proposed: standard view, Dock Strip/Square, Ghost Caption/Coin, hotkey; muted-state indication.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-174/mic-mute.html (opens in a browser, no build) showing the mute control and muted state in the standard recording view and in each compact widget, with a clickable toggle; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] Recommendation given; the user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Touches high-risk shared files (systemCapture.ts, electron main) — both platforms must be analysed. Roadmap: M2 Live session control. Order: 5/10.

## Decision (2026-11-03)
- Engine: A. A GainNode set to 0 between micSource and recordDest (FileUpload.tsx:380-390), with track.enabled=false as the fallback when the Web Audio graph is unavailable. The timeline is kept, the speech gate drops silent live chunks, and Silero VAD skips the silence after recording. Mute is renderer-only on Windows and macOS: the server capture only produces the system track.
- Rejected: C, pausing or stopping the mic track (desyncs [Me] from [Them]; against the 2026-10-29 decision). D, gap markers alone (noise is still recorded).
- UI: mockup Variant 1 · Control everywhere (@docs/mockups/AUG-174/mic-mute.html). Mute control in the standard view (Mic node + live top bar) and in all four compact widgets, a global hotkey Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+M, a tray item, and a red MIC OFF indicator.
- Extras chosen by the user: configurable mute hotkey, "— mic muted —" gap marker in the live and final transcript, muteIntervals in session.json (no UI), and a "You're muted in August" hint when the user speaks while muted.
- Implementation task: AUG-181-rij341.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-03)
**Что сделано:**
- Разобран аудио-пайплайн с file:line: микрофон пишется только в renderer (Web Audio граф → MediaRecorder), серверный захват даёт только системный трек.
- Сравнены 4 подхода к муту (gain=0 / track.enabled / пауза трека / только маркеры) по синхронизации, live, пост-транскрипции и обеим платформам.
- Сделан HTML-макет с двумя вариантами UI во всех видах (стандартный, Dock Strip/Square, Ghost Caption/Coin, трей, хоткей).
- Пользователь выбрал Вариант 1 + все 4 доп. опции; создана задача реализации AUG-181.
**Как:** GainNode между micSource и recordDest сохраняет длину файла → выравнивание [Me]/[Them] по micStartedAt не ломается; live speech gate и Silero VAD сами отбрасывают тишину. Отвергнуты пауза/stop трека (рассинхрон) и маркеры без мута (шум остаётся).
**Файлы:** @docs/mockups/AUG-174/mic-mute.html; контекст: @project-context/architecture/README.md, @project-context/frontend-design/README.md, @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
**PR / коммиты:** в этой сессии не коммитилось (политика — коммит прямо в master); веток под задачу не создавалось.
**Грабли:** субагент собрал compact-виджеты макета по спеке, не читая реальный CSS — близко к оригиналу, но не пиксель-в-пиксель. hotkey.ts вызывает globalShortcut.unregisterAll() — второй хоткей требует рефакторинга (учтено в AUG-181).
**Хвосты:** реализация и ручная проверка Windows/macOS — в AUG-181 (сейчас to_review, ручные проверки pending).
